options swap_delay=12 iteration=1000;

skirk char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9 +params=[start_serpents_subtlety=0];
skirk add weapon="azurelight" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
skirk add set="finaleofthedeepgalleries" count=4;
skirk add stats er=0.1102;

furina char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9 +params=[start_energy=0];
furina add weapon="favsword" refine=3 lvl=90/90;
furina add set="totm" count=4;
furina add stats er=0.2204;

yelan char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9 +params=[start_energy=0];
yelan add weapon="favbow" refine=3 lvl=90/90;
yelan add set="no" count=4;
yelan add stats er=0.1102;

escoffier char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9 +params=[start_energy=0];
escoffier add weapon="favlance" refine=3 lvl=90/90;
escoffier add set="scroll" count=4;
escoffier add stats er=0.4408;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999 freeze_resist=1;
energy every interval=480,720 amount=1;

active furina;
furina attack, skill, dash;
escoffier skill, attack:3;
yelan skill, attack:2, dash, attack:2;
skirk skill,
      attack:5, dash,
      attack:2, burst,
      attack:5, dash,
      attack:5, dash,
      attack:2, charge, dash,
      attack:5, dash,
      attack:2;

furina swap;
for let i=0; i<1; i=i+1 {
  furina burst, skill, dash;
  escoffier skill, burst;
  yelan skill, attack, burst, attack;
  skirk skill,
        attack:2, burst,
        attack:5, dash,
        attack:5, dash,
        attack:5, dash,
        attack:2, charge, dash,
        attack:5, dash,
        attack:2;
}
